integrity: Full proof and a standard-library computational check are supplied. Simulation is supporting evidence, not proof. Historical priority and mathematical correctness are not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Proves an exact rank-collapse identity and a three-regime vanishing-noise limit for two raw equally weighted time-point rank scores and fixed bounded continuous group densities. Does not establish actual rejection probability, smooth-preprocessed test behavior, or power of randomized procedures.
title: A sharp \(N^{-2}\) anti-phase collapse threshold for doubly ranked functional tests
